executive_verdict.primary_failure_mode: Previously disconnected workflow and incomplete input lineage; fixed and exercised on live AWS.
executive_verdict.most_urgent_fix: Completed: compose the real worker and enforce fact provenance before publication.

findings.title: AWS worker and API were disconnected
findings.mechanism: Default runtime exposed unavailable providers despite deployed infrastructure.
findings.recommended_fix: Connect frozen request preparation to asynchronous dispatch, repository checkpoints and real code controls.

findings.title: Calculated facts lacked dependency lineage
findings.mechanism: The signing ledger correctly distrusted computed numbers without registered inputs.
findings.root_cause: Quant producers registered aggregate values without source/allocation dependency facts.
findings.recommended_fix: Register gated-series hash receipts and explicit allocation assumptions; retain code-owned verification.

findings.title: Planner could invent tool names
findings.mechanism: The first live brief was rejected before calculations because the proposed name was outside the catalog.
findings.recommended_fix: Constrain computation names in the model schema and supply the exact allowed catalog.

findings.title: Preliminary output policy blocked valid historical analysis
findings.mechanism: Live drafts reached audit but the Classic-tier denied-topic policy falsely intervened.
findings.root_cause: The preliminary policy was not evaluated against a complete real brief.
findings.recommended_fix: Freeze a Standard-tier policy after testing the exact prior draft and an unsafe trading promise; scope IAM to its regional profiles.

findings.title: Large ledger checkpoints could exceed DynamoDB transaction item limits
findings.mechanism: A run adding many facts in one phase could not publish a checkpoint atomically.
findings.root_cause: All fact children were required in one transaction without a large-ledger path.
findings.recommended_fix: Publish a revision-fenced aggregate ledger document with content-addressed S3 spill and preserved fact immutability.

findings.title: Base-table checkpoint queries reread every child
findings.mechanism: Each workflow checkpoint incurred unnecessary GetItem calls after a strongly consistent Query.
findings.root_cause: Query and read logic treated base rows like eventually consistent index projections.
findings.recommended_fix: Decode base Query items directly while retaining META revision fences and index ownership rereads.

findings.title: Workflow failures were poorly observable
findings.mechanism: Handled model/audit failures need separate visibility from platform Lambda errors.
findings.root_cause: No run-correlated custom outcome/token telemetry or retained failure destination.
findings.recommended_fix: Emit low-cardinality EMF metrics, provide a dashboard and alarms, and retain exhausted asynchronous delivery failures in encrypted SQS.
